data.situation: Patient of age not recorded presents at triage level RED with the main complaint: Doctor sahib, there is severe pain in the chest, it is going to the left arm, and I am sweating a lot. It has been for half an hour.
data.background: Symptoms reported include chest pain, sweating, arm jaw pain, and severe pain with a duration of about 30 minutes. Red flags mentioned include سینے میں بہت درد ہے، بائیں بازو تک جا رہا ہے، اور بہت پسینہ آ رہا ہے.
data.assessment: Meets triage criteria for possible heart attack due to chest pain + sweating + arm jaw pain, age unknown. Also meets triage criteria for severe pain due to severe pain reported.
data.recommendation: Transfer to Rawalpindi Institute of Cardiology for the cath lab. No medicines already prescribed.
